title: Project Glasswing: Securing critical software for the AI era
raw_excerpt: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview autonomously identified thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities across major operating systems and browsers. Project Glasswing, in partnership with major tech companies, uses these capabilities to enhance cybersecurity by detecting and fixing vulnerabilities at scale. Anthropic plans to develop safeguards and broaden industry cooperation to address security challenges in the AI era.
summary: Anthropic 发布 Project Glasswing，利用 Claude Mythos Preview 模型自主发现数千个零日漏洞，覆盖主流操作系统和浏览器。该项目与多家科技公司合作，旨在规模化检测和修复漏洞，提升网络安全。Anthropic 计划开发防护措施并扩大行业合作，以应对 AI 时代的安全挑战。

title: GLM-5.1: Towards Long-Horizon Tasks
raw_excerpt: GLM-5.1 is a flagship model for agentic engineering created by Z.ai. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench Pro. The model is built to stay effective on agent tasks over much longer horizons than previous generations. It can sustain optimization over hundreds of rounds and thousands of tool calls. The model breaks complex problems down, runs experiments, reads results, and identifies blockers with real precision.
summary: Z.ai 发布 GLM-5.1 模型，专为长周期代理任务设计，在 SWE-Bench Pro 上达到 SOTA。该模型能在数百轮交互和数千次工具调用中保持优化能力，自主分解复杂问题、运行实验、读取结果并精准识别障碍，显著提升了 AI 代理在长期任务中的可靠性。

title: Waypoint-1.5: Higher-Fidelity Interactive Worlds for Everyday GPUs
summary: Hugging Face 发布 Waypoint-1.5，一个可在普通 GPU 上运行的高保真交互式世界生成模型。该模型在保持视觉质量的同时大幅降低计算需求，使更多研究者能够探索交互式环境生成，为游戏、模拟和机器人等领域提供新的可能性。

title: Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models with Sentence Transformers
summary: Hugging Face 发布基于 Sentence Transformers 的多模态嵌入与重排序模型，支持文本、图像等多种模态的统一表示。该工具可提升检索增强生成（RAG）系统的性能，为多模态搜索和问答提供更精确的语义匹配能力。

title: AI Can't Read an Investor Deck
raw_excerpt: Current AI models struggle with interpreting complex financial documents, especially with visual data extraction. GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Claude Opus 4.6 consistently falter when processing dense charts and images, only achieving 56% to 64% accuracy compared to 72% to 80% with text-only inputs. These findings highlight significant gaps in AI's ability to perform real-world financial reasoning tasks, making the displacement of financial analysts with AI appear premature.
summary: Mercor 研究显示，当前顶级 AI 模型（如 GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.6）在处理复杂金融文档中的图表时准确率仅 56%-64%，远低于纯文本输入的 72%-80%。这表明 AI 在真实金融推理任务中存在显著短板，短期内难以取代金融分析师。

title: TriAttention for KV Cache Compression (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: TriAttention estimates KV importance in pre-RoPE space using stable Q/K centers and distance-based scoring, preserving long-context reasoning quality while sharply reducing KV memory use and improving throughput.
summary: TriAttention 开源项目提出一种新的 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过预 RoPE 空间中的稳定 Q/K 中心与距离评分来估计键值重要性，在保持长上下文推理质量的同时大幅减少内存占用并提升吞吐量，为长序列模型部署提供高效方案。

title: Faster MoE Inference with Warp Decode
raw_excerpt: Cursor's “warp decode” is a kernel design that reorganizes MoE inference around output neurons instead of experts. It achieves ~1.8x higher throughput and improved numerical accuracy on Blackwell GPUs.
summary: Cursor 推出“warp decode”内核设计，将 MoE 推理重新组织为以输出神经元为中心而非专家为中心。在 Blackwell GPU 上，该方法实现约 1.8 倍吞吐量提升和更好的数值精度，为大规模 MoE 模型的高效推理开辟新路径。

title: TorchTPU: Running PyTorch Natively on TPUs at Google Scale
raw_excerpt: Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) are foundational to the company's supercomputing infrastructure. The company's custom ASICs power training and serving for Google and its Cloud customers. TorchTPU is a stack that makes it easy for the AI community to access the full capabilities of TPUs. It provides the APIs and tools needed to extract every ounce of compute from Google's hardware. This post takes a look under the hood at the engineering principles behind TorchTPU.
summary: Google 发布 TorchTPU，一套让 PyTorch 原生运行于 TPU 的软件栈，提供 API 和工具以充分利用 Google 定制 ASIC 的计算能力。该技术使 AI 社区能更便捷地访问 TPU 超算资源，推动大规模训练与推理的民主化。

title: We're actually running out of benchmarks to upper bound AI capabilities
raw_excerpt: METR's Time Horizon suite is being saturated. Frontier AI models can reliably do all but maybe a dozen or so tasks in the suite, making it hard to upper bound their time horizon. New benchmarks are becoming more expensive to grade and create. The situation will likely get worse as AI progress continues. It is likely that, by mid-2027, no benchmark score from a 2026 or earlier benchmark will be able to rule out dangerous capabilities from frontier AI systems.
summary: METR 指出其 Time Horizon 基准套件正被前沿 AI 模型迅速饱和，仅剩十余项任务未被攻克。新基准的创建和评分成本日益高昂，预计到 2027 年中，现有基准将无法有效排除前沿 AI 系统的危险能力，引发对安全评估的担忧。

title: Elon Musk Asks for OpenAI's Nonprofit to Get Any Damages From His Lawsuit
raw_excerpt: Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI is expected to go to trial later this month in Oakland, California. Musk has amended the lawsuit to ask that any damages he might win be awarded to OpenAI's charitable arm rather than to himself. The amendment also asks that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman be removed from the OpenAI nonprofit's board. Musk is seeking more than $150 billion in damages from both OpenAI and Microsoft as he believes OpenAI strayed from its non-profit mission and defrauded him as a donor in seeking to convert to a for-profit company.
summary: Elon Musk 修改对 OpenAI 的诉讼，要求将可能获得的超过 1500 亿美元赔偿判给 OpenAI 的慈善机构而非个人，并请求将 CEO Sam Altman 从非营利董事会中移除。该案即将在加州开庭，核心争议在于 OpenAI 是否背离非营利使命。
